description: Copy SQL dumps, CSV, JSON, or log files with every piece of Indonesian personal data replaced by a realistic stand-in, for staging, seeders, tests, or sharing with a vendor: valid NIKs in the same district with the same gender and birth year, phone numbers on the same operator, names with the same casing, addresses in the same area, e-mail at example.com. The same value gets the same stand-in in every file of one call, so joins still work. Runs on the user's machine and returns only counts: you never see the data. Use it instead of reading production data, and when asked to copy production data to staging or build seeders from it.

keep.description: Types to leave as they are, e.g. ["FINANCIAL"] for a credit simulation

keep_birth_date.description: Keep whole birth dates instead of only the year

output.description: Output file, or a folder when there are several inputs

paths.description: Input files, relative to the project root

secret.description: The same secret gives the same stand-ins on every run

name: anonymize_file
title: Make a copy of data with realistic stand-ins (Kembaran)
